The '''Federal Correctional Institution, Cumberland''' ('''FCI Cumberland''') is a medium-security United States [[federal prison]] for male inmates in Maryland. It is operated by the [[Federal Bureau of Prisons]], a division of the [[United States Department of Justice]]. The facility also has a satellite prison camp for minimum-security male offenders.<ref>{{cite web|title=FCI Cumberland|url=http://www.bop.gov/locations/institutions/cum/index.jsp|publisher=Federal Bureau of Prisons}}</ref>

FCI Cumberland is located in [[unincorporated area|unincorporated]] [[Allegany County, Maryland|Allegany County]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www2.census.gov/geo/maps/DC2020/DC20BLK/st24_md/county/c24001_allegany/DC20BLK_C24001.pdf|title=2020 CENSUS - CENSUS BLOCK MAP: Allegany County, MD|publisher=[[U.S. Census Bureau]]|access-date=2024-08-05|page=23 (PDF p. 24/42)|quote=Federal Correctional Institution Cumberland}}</ref> western [[Maryland]], {{convert|130|mi|km}} northwest of [[Washington, D.C.]]

FCI Cumberland also has a [[vehicle registration plate|license plate]] manufacturing center, where inmates produce license plates used on federal government vehicles.
